name: configurable-notification-system
description: Configurable notification system - define when and how notifications are delivered

scripts.build: npm run build -w @cns/shared && npm run build -w @cns/api && npm run build -w @cns/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @cns/shared --if-present && npm run test -w @cns/api && npm run test -w @cns/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @cns/shared && npm run typecheck -w @cns/api && npm run typecheck -w @cns/web
